correctness.rationale: Signed-coordinate group averaging reduces all arbitrary real-linear extensions to two coefficients with a+b=1/d. Two explicit one-Lipschitz dual witnesses give A(b) and F(b) meeting uniquely at b*. The positive a*,b* kernel attains the lower envelope: exact KR transport analyzes incident/opposite vertex-centroid pairs and all k-coordinate facet-center pairs. The k>=2 derangement attains the sqrt2 lower transportation bound. B(0)<=A(0) for d>=3, A increasing and B decreasing, completing all quantifiers. The standard-library checker passed 1264 vertex-facet and 2660 facet-facet pairs for d=3..6, independent LP for d=3..5; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact least linear extension norm of the canonical full facet-centroid refinement is a natural metric/Banach invariant for every cross-polytope dimension. Positive, fully supported weights simultaneously control exponentially many centroid pairs and strictly beat the naive face-local averaging operator. This is not a table lookup or a trivial substitution of a single-point extension result; the opposite-facet obstruction and global derangement coupling are structurally necessary.
